subScenes.name: 寻找商品区
subScenes.description: 询问牛奶或面包所在的货架区域。

qaPairs.triggerText: Could you tell me where I can find the dairy products?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你能告诉我乳制品区在哪里吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问乳制品区位置

followUps.text: Sure, it's in aisle 3, right next to the eggs and butter.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，在3号通道，就在鸡蛋和黄油旁边。

followUps.text: We don't have a dedicated dairy section right now — they're all on the refrigerated shelf near the entrance.
followUps.text_cn: 目前没有专门的乳制品区，所有商品都在入口附近的冷藏货架上。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, I'm new here too — maybe you can check the digital map at the entrance?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我也是新来的——也许您可以去入口处看下电子导览图？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于顾客在超市寻找常见商品区时的典型询问，服务员可能因库存、布局或经验差异给出不同回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is the organic section on the second floor?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客确认有机食品区位置

followUps.text: No, it's on the first floor, aisle 7 — we moved it last week.
followUps.text_cn: 不在，它在一楼7号通道——我们上周刚搬过去。

followUps.text: Actually, we don't have an organic section — but we do have a 'natural foods' aisle in aisle 5.
followUps.text_cn: 实际上我们没有专门的有机区，但5号通道有‘天然食品’专区。

followUps.text: Let me check for you — one second.
followUps.text_cn: 我帮您查一下——等一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常因超市宣传或过往经验产生误解，服务员需灵活应对不同情况，包括信息更新、分类差异或需核实。

qaPairs.triggerText: Where can I find gluten-free snacks?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客寻找特殊饮食需求商品

followUps.text: They're in aisle 9, right next to the health food supplements.
followUps.text_cn: 在9号通道，就在健康食品补充剂旁边。

followUps.text: We don't carry gluten-free snacks — but you can try the pharmacy next door, they have a small selection.
followUps.text_cn: 我们不卖无麸质零食——但隔壁药店有少量货品，您可以去那里看看。

followUps.text: We used to have them, but they're out of stock until next Monday. Would you like me to notify you when they're back?
followUps.text_cn: 我们之前有，但目前断货，下周一才补货。您需要我通知您到货吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 针对特殊饮食需求的顾客，服务员回应需体现专业性与同理心，可能涉及缺货、无库存或替代建议等真实情境。

subScenes.name: 确认计量单位
subScenes.description: 咨询商品是按公斤、升还是个数售卖。

qaPairs.triggerText: How much do you want? Per kilo or by piece?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您要多少？按公斤还是按个计？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 超市中，店员确认水果/蔬菜的计量单位

followUps.text: I'll take two kilos, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我要两公斤。

followUps.text: Just three pieces, thanks.
followUps.text_cn: 三个就行，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you sell them by the bag? I'd prefer that.
followUps.text_cn: 你们有袋装的吗？我更喜欢袋装的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于确认商品计量方式，常见于水果、蔬菜、坚果等散装商品

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you want it by the liter or the bottle?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您要按升买还是按瓶买？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 超市中，店员确认饮料或油类商品的计量方式

followUps.text: I'll take one liter, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我要一升。

followUps.text: I'll grab a bottle instead—it's more convenient.
followUps.text_cn: 我拿一瓶吧，更方便。

followUps.text: Is there a discount if I buy three liters?
followUps.text_cn: 如果我买三升有优惠吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 常用于牛奶、果汁、食用油等液体商品，顾客需明确购买单位

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you buying this by the pound or by the pack?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您是按磅买还是按包装买？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 超市中，店员确认肉类或奶酪等商品的计量方式

followUps.text: I need one pound, sliced thin.
followUps.text_cn: 我要一磅，切薄一点。

followUps.text: I'll take the pre-packaged one—it's already portioned.
followUps.text_cn: 我拿预包装的就行，已经分好份了。

followUps.text: Can I get half a pound from the bulk bin?
followUps.text_cn: 我能从散装区称半磅吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 常见于奶酪、火腿、牛肉等需称重的商品，顾客可能有特殊切割或包装偏好

subScenes.name: 询问促销信息
subScenes.description: 了解当前折扣、买赠或优惠券使用规则。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there any promotion going on right now?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客在超市询问当前促销信息

followUps.text: Yes, we have a 20% discount on all dairy products this week.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，本周所有乳制品打八折。

followUps.text: Not at the moment, but we usually have sales on weekends.
followUps.text_cn: 目前没有，但我们周末通常有促销。

followUps.text: Actually, there's a limited-time offer: buy one get one free on canned beans until tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 实际上，现在有个限时优惠：罐装豆类买一送一，截止到明天。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常用此句询问当前优惠，服务员回应需清晰说明促销内容、范围和期限。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you tell me if this item is on sale?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 能告诉我这个商品在打折吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客指着具体商品询问是否参与促销

followUps.text: Yes, this is part of our weekly special — it's $2 off today.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，这是本周特惠商品，今天直降2美元。

followUps.text: No, this item isn't on sale, but we have a similar brand on discount nearby.
followUps.text_cn: 这个商品没打折，但附近有类似品牌正在促销。

followUps.text: It’s not on sale, but if you buy two, you get a free bottle of water.
followUps.text_cn: 这个没打折，但买两个送一瓶水。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客针对单品询问促销，服务员回应需具体到商品，避免笼统回答。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any loyalty discounts or coupons I can use?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有会员折扣或优惠券可以用吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问会员或优惠券类促销权益

followUps.text: Yes, our app offers exclusive coupons — just scan your loyalty card at checkout.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我们的App有专属优惠券，结账时刷一下会员卡即可使用。

followUps.text: We don’t accept third-party coupons, but members get 5% off every purchase.
followUps.text_cn: 我们不接受第三方优惠券，但会员每次购物享5%折扣。

followUps.text: Sorry, we don’t have coupons right now, but you can sign up for our newsletter for future deals.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，目前没有优惠券，但您可以订阅我们的电子报获取未来促销信息。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客关注会员或优惠券权益，服务员回应需区分是否支持外部券、会员机制和替代方案。

subScenes.name: 寻找收银台
subScenes.description: 向店员询问最近的收银台位置。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客在超市内寻找收银台位置

followUps.text: Right over there, next to the water bottles.
followUps.text_cn: 就在那边，水瓶旁边。

followUps.text: There are two checkouts — one at the front, one at the back. The front one is less busy.
followUps.text_cn: 有两个收银台，前面一个和后面一个。前面那个人少。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, the checkouts are closed right now. Please wait a few minutes or use the self-checkout over there.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，收银台现在关闭了，请稍等几分钟，或者用那边的自助结账机。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于顾客在超市内找不到收银台时的典型询问，服务员根据不同运营状态给出回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you tell me which line to join?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客面对多个收银通道，不确定该选哪一队

followUps.text: Go to the express lane if you have 10 items or less.
followUps.text_cn: 如果您不超过10件商品，请排快速通道。

followUps.text: The middle line is moving fastest right now — the cashier there is very quick.
followUps.text_cn: 中间那条队现在最快，那里的收银员效率很高。

followUps.text: Sorry, we only allow self-checkout for customers with more than 15 items. Please use the machines near the exit.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，超过15件商品的顾客只能使用自助结账机，请到出口附近的自助机结账。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在多个收银通道前犹豫时的典型提问，服务员根据规则或实时情况引导

qaPairs.triggerText: Is this the right place to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客对收银台位置不确定，可能误入非结账区域

followUps.text: Yes, this is the main checkout. Just line up here and we'll scan your items.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，这是主收银台，请排队，我们会扫描您的商品。

followUps.text: No, that’s the customer service desk. The checkouts are to your left, past the dairy section.
followUps.text_cn: 不是，那是客户服务台。收银台在您左边，穿过乳制品区。

followUps.text: That’s the self-checkout station — you can scan and pay yourself. If you need help, just press the help button.
followUps.text_cn: 那是自助结账机，您可以自己扫描付款。如果需要帮助，请按帮助按钮。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客对收银区域功能不确定时的试探性提问，服务员需明确区分功能区域并提供操作指引

subScenes.name: 结账礼貌致谢
subScenes.description: 完成付款后向收银员礼貌道谢。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thank you for shopping with us!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 结账后服务员礼貌致谢，顾客回应

followUps.text: Thank you, you've been so helpful!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，您太帮忙了！

followUps.text: Have a great day!
followUps.text_cn: 祝你今天愉快！

followUps.text: Thanks! The checkout was quick.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！结账很快。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是超市结账环节最自然的致谢回应方式，适用于任何支付方式完成后的场景。避免只说 'You're welcome'，它更适合回应 'Sorry' 或 'Excuse me'，而非感谢。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 结账结束时服务员的常见祝福语，顾客回应

followUps.text: You too!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！

followUps.text: Thanks! I hope your shift goes well.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！希望你值班顺利。

followUps.text: Same to you—I’m heading to the bus stop now!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我现在要去赶公交了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 此句常与 'Thank you for shopping with us' 交替使用，回应时应简短温暖，避免长篇大论。'You too!' 是母语者最常用、最地道的回应。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客离开前服务员的二次致谢，顾客回应

followUps.text: I’ll be back next week!
followUps.text_cn: 我下周还会再来！

followUps.text: I really appreciate your service.
followUps.text_cn: 我真的很感谢你们的服务。

followUps.text: Thanks—I’m just grabbing a few more things.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我再拿点东西就走。

qaPairs.usageNote: 此句常用于顾客已拿好购物袋、即将离开时，回应需体现即时性。第三种情况反映真实场景中顾客可能尚未完全离开，对话有延展性。
